sections.heading: Certification
paragraphs: Certificate BF-ISMS-2026 covers payment processing, cloud operations and the Mumbai and Pune operations centres through 2027-03-31. The last independent surveillance found no major security nonconformities.

ISO privacy controls are supported by the security risk register, access governance and supplier-security clauses. This certification states no conclusion about the separate statutory privacy obligations of consumer-facing processing.

sections.heading: Operating proof
paragraphs: Quarterly privilege reviews, encrypted backups, phishing-resistant MFA, JIT access and supplier penetration-test reports were sampled by the external auditor in August 2026. SIEM event logs are retained for 365 days and sampled weekly. Exception closure was independently checked.
